charge_port.notes: Estimated: BMW Canada says native NACS only on all-new 2026+ models; the Countryman SE is assumed to keep the Combo 1 port as the Cooper SE F56 (Wikipedia). No page read names the port.

supercharger_access.notes: BMW Canada: MINI BEVs get Supercharger access with a software update and the Lectron adapter (Canada). US assumed the same.

wheels.notes: Countryman SE ALL4: 18 x 7.5 in aluminum, P225/55R18. (US page; Canadian cars assumed the same.)
Countryman 2025 (S ALL4 page): John Cooper Works Style package lists 19 x 8 in wheels, 245/45R19; the SE page lists only the 18 in Favoured Style. (US page; Canadian cars assumed the same.)
